label: Slicing the solid
subgoals: Write the area of a section

visual.title: A solid sliced into disks
visual.caption: Drag to turn the solid. Each slice at the cut is a disk of radius r(x), and the volume is the integral of those disk areas along the axis.

predict.question: Move the cut to where the body is widest. What happens to the cross-section area there?
predict.explain: The slice is a disk of radius r(x), so its area is largest where the profile is widest.
